description: Adds a new series to the current chart.

params.description: The series name. Can be a range of cells or usual text. For example:"'sheet 1'!$A$2:$A$5" - must be a single cell, row or column,"A1:A5" - must be a single cell, row or column,"Example series".
params.name: sNameRange

params.description: A range of cells from the sheet with series values. For example:"'sheet 1'!$A$2:$A$5" - must be a single cell, row or column,"A1:A5" - must be a single cell, row or column.
params.name: sValuesRange

params.description: A range of cells from the sheet with series x-axis values. It is used with the scatter charts only. For example:"'sheet 1'!$A$2:$A$5" - must be a single cell, row or column,"A1:A5" - must be a single cell, row or column.
params.name: sXValuesRange

signature: AddSeria(sNameRange: string, sValuesRange: string, sXValuesRange?: string): void
